mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a term of POS expression, which contains all the variables of the function in true or complemented form."
Maxterm is a term of POS expression, which contains all the variables of the function in true or complemented form.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an electronic circuit which produces a typical output signal depending on its input signal."
A logic gate is an electronic circuit which produces a typical output signal depending on its input signal.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the amount of information that can be held in a register at a time for processing."
Register size refers to the amount of information that can be held in a register at a time for processing.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a set of all the bits of the same bit position of a specific set of words."
A bit-slice is a set of all the bits of the same bit position of a specific set of words.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used for starting input/output using an I/O channels."
Privileged I/O Instructions These instructions are used for starting input/output using an I/O channels.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used for input of data from input device and the WRITE command is used for output of data to input device."
The READ command is used for input of data from input device and the WRITE command is used for output of data to input device.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as a particular instance of instruction execution."
A state is defined as a particular instance of instruction execution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in digital circuits for data and control signal routing."
The multiplexers are used in digital circuits for data and control signal routing.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as an algebraic expression formed with the binary variables, the logic operation symbols, parenthesis, and equal to sign."
A Boolean function is defined as an algebraic expression formed with the binary variables, the logic operation symbols, parenthesis, and equal to sign.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a unit of information required by the CPU for execution."
An instruction element is a unit of information required by the CPU for execution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used only for storing intermediate results or data."
The data registers are used only for storing intermediate results or data.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used for bringing in data from the memory to CPU registers."
Data movement instructions are used for bringing in data from the memory to CPU registers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are called universal functions since with either one the AND and OR functions and NOT can be generated."
The NAND and NOR gates are called universal functions since with either one the AND and OR functions and NOT can be generated.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a destructive readout hence it requires writing along with a reading operation."
The reading process is a destructive readout hence it requires writing along with a reading operation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the earliest storage devices."
The tape is one of the earliest storage devices.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an AND gate with a small circle on the output."
The symbol is an AND gate with a small circle on the output.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an attempt to represent the true-false logic of humans in mathematical form."
The Boolean algebra is an attempt to represent the true-false logic of humans in mathematical form.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used for transmission of commands and timing signals (which validate data and address) between the system modules."
The control lines are used for transmission of commands and timing signals (which validate data and address) between the system modules.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an extension of the concept of a DMA."
The concept of an I/O processor is an extension of the concept of a DMA.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used for some of these chips where writing mode is not disabled in personal computers."
Flash memories are used for some of these chips where writing mode is not disabled in personal computers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a section of disk data and is normally equal to one or more sector(s)."
A block is a section of disk data and is normally equal to one or more sector(s).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the minimal solutions."
The expression is one of the minimal solutions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called explicitly by a program statement."
A subroutine is called explicitly by a program statement.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used for storing a bit of a word."
A separate flip-flop is used for storing a bit of a word.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used for serial printers and terminals."
Serial interface is used for serial printers and terminals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an electronic medium therefore, there is a possibility of errors being introduced during the transmission of data."
The computer is an electronic medium therefore, there is a possibility of errors being introduced during the transmission of data.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a 32-bit bus that normally runs at 33 MHz or 66 MHz etc."
PCI is a 32-bit bus that normally runs at 33 MHz or 66 MHz etc.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most complex yet interesting and very much analysed aspect of computer design."
Instruction set design is the most complex yet interesting and very much analysed aspect of computer design.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to designate the source of data for the data bus."
The address bus is used to designate the source of data for the data bus.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is known as the channel in IBM machines."
The I/O processor is known as the channel in IBM machines.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used for connecting an arithmetic processor to the CPU."
Two mechanisms are used for connecting an arithmetic processor to the CPU.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to store instructions and operands within the CPU."
The CPU registers are used to store instructions and operands within the CPU.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to connect the CPU to a central switch True False 5."
The system bus is used to connect the CPU to a central switch True False 5.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used for counting the number of times an event occurs and are useful for generating the timing signals for controlling the sequence of operations in digital computers."
The counters are used for counting the number of times an event occurs and are useful for generating the timing signals for controlling the sequence of operations in digital computers.
fib: ______ is defined as the information that is stored or retrieved in the memory per second.
Bandwidth
Bandwidth is defined as the information that is stored or retrieved in the memory per second.
______ is a ring shaped ferrite material, which is used for storing binary information.
core
The core is a ring shaped ferrite material, which is used for storing binary information.
______ is a special type of flip-flop in the sense that it represents the currently applied input as the state of the flip-flop.
D flip-flop
D Flip-Flop D flip-flop is a special type of flip-flop in the sense that it represents the currently applied input as the state of the flip-flop.
______ is a set of connections between two or more components/devices that are designed to transfer several/all bits of a word from a specific source to destination.
bus
Bus Interconnection A bus is a set of connections between two or more components/devices that are designed to transfer several/all bits of a word from a specific source to destination.
______ is a form of control code, which supplies the information about an operation and the data on which the operation is to be performed.
Obviously an instruction
Obviously an instruction is a form of control code, which supplies the information about an operation and the data on which the operation is to be performed.
______ is a true secondary storage device (unlike CD- ROMs and WORM).
erasable optical disk
The erasable optical disk is a true secondary storage device (unlike CD- ROMs and WORM).
______ is a special gate whose output is one only if the inputs are not equal.
Exclusive OR (XOR)
Exclusive OR
XOR
Exclusive OR (XOR) is a special gate whose output is one only if the inputs are not equal.
______ is a mid-way between hardware and software.
firmware
The firmware is a mid-way between hardware and software.
______ is used to define the layout of the bits allocated to these elements of instructions.
instruction format
An instruction format is used to define the layout of the bits allocated to these elements of instructions.
______ refers to a physical address in a non- virtual memory environment and refers to a register in a virtual memory address environment.
symbol EA (Effective Address)
symbol EA
The symbol EA (Effective Address) refers to a physical address in a non- virtual memory environment and refers to a register in a virtual memory address environment.
______ is a special register used for the implementation of multiplication and division.
MQ (Multiplier- Quotient register)
MQ
The MQ (Multiplier- Quotient register) is a special register used for the implementation of multiplication and division.
______ is a collection of all the instructions a CPU can execute.
instruction set
An instruction set is a collection of all the instructions a CPU can execute.
______ is used to magnetise the core, and even after the current is removed the ferrite material stays in the specific magnetic state.
Electronic current
Electronic current is used to magnetise the core, and even after the current is removed the ferrite material stays in the specific magnetic state.
______ is a LIFO (Last In First Out) data structure.
stack
The stack is a LIFO (Last In First Out) data structure.
______ is used for transferring data from input/output module or part to a destination which may be the main memory or processor register.
READ (or INPUT) This command
READ This command
READ (or INPUT) This command is used for transferring data from input/output module or part to a destination which may be the main memory or processor register.
______ is the interface between the I/ O module and the peripheral devices.
external interface
The external interface is the interface between the I/ O module and the peripheral devices.
______ are used for not only storing the return address but are also used for storing the parameters which are to be passed to the subroutine which is called.
Stacks
Stacks are used for not only storing the return address but are also used for storing the parameters which are to be passed to the subroutine which is called.
______ is a binary cell, which can store a bit of information and which in itself is a sequential circuit.
flip-flop
A flip-flop is a binary cell, which can store a bit of information and which in itself is a sequential circuit.
______ are the memories on which it is not possible to write the data when they are online to the computer.
ROMs (Read Only Memories)
ROMs
ROMs (Read Only Memories) are the memories on which it is not possible to write the data when they are online to the computer.
______ is used for storing the instruction which is to be executed next.
Program Status Word (PSW)
Program Status Word
PSW
Program Status Word (PSW) is used for storing the instruction which is to be executed next.
______ is a circuit which will give a high output if either, but not both, of its two inputs are high.
'Exclusive-OR' gate
EXOR gate The 'Exclusive-OR' gate is a circuit which will give a high output if either, but not both, of its two inputs are high.
______ are used to indicate the current state of a device, e.g., the device is busy, the system BUS is busy, the device is out of order etc.
status registers
The status registers are used to indicate the current state of a device, e.g., the device is busy, the system BUS is busy, the device is out of order etc.
______ are the other two control lines for bus control.
bus busy
The bus request and bus busy are the other two control lines for bus control.
______ is a must as it is useful in scientific calculations.
Yet the floating-point representation
Yet the floating-point representation is a must as it is useful in scientific calculations.
______ is a direct extension of audio CD.
CD-ROM (compact disk read-only memory)
CD-ROM
The CD-ROM The CD-ROM (compact disk read-only memory) is a direct extension of audio CD.
______ is a word organised unit with each word representing a microinstruction.
control memory
The control memory is a word organised unit with each word representing a microinstruction.
______ is a very simple system yet it exhibits a wide range of technology and types.
memory system
A memory system is a very simple system yet it exhibits a wide range of technology and types.
______ is a two-state device made from silicon.
transistor
A transistor is a two-state device made from silicon.
______ is a register whose value is incremented by one on the occurrence of some event.
counter in principle
A counter in principle is a register whose value is incremented by one on the occurrence of some event.
______ is a simple direct approach of simplification of logical expressions.
Karnaugh map
The Karnaugh map is a simple direct approach of simplification of logical expressions.
______ is used for a fetch cycle in a typical CPU.
program counter
A program counter is used for a fetch cycle in a typical CPU.
______ is a special byte that signifies the starting of a field.
synchronisation byte
The synchronisation byte is a special byte that signifies the starting of a field.
______ is a sequence of instructions designed for achieving a task or goal.
program
A program is a sequence of instructions designed for achieving a task or goal.
